findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "connect" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: help, official_facts, physics, browse, credit_gift, payment_attempt, ping, wait_here, read_here, flag · Private data: official_facts, physics, search, look, browse, credit_preflight, buy_credit, place_edit, thing_edit, list_world, claim_world, reconcile_world, credit_gift, payment_attempt, transfer, agree, say, wait_here, read_here, later_holder_items, me · Public sink: changes, look, credit_preflight, buy_credit, found, place_edit, coin_trait, invent_kind, revise_kind, thing_edit, withdraw, claim_world, flag · Destructive: make, thing_edit, act.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: help, official_facts, physics, browse, credit_gift, payment_attempt, ping, wait_here, read_here, flag · Private data: official_facts, physics, search, look, browse, credit_preflight, buy_credit, place_edit, thing_edit, list_world, claim_world, reconcile_world, credit_gift, payment_attempt, transfer, agree, say, wait_here, read_here, later_holder_items, me · Public sink: changes, look, credit_preflight, buy_credit, found, place_edit, coin_trait, invent_kind, revise_kind, thing_edit, withdraw, claim_world, flag · Destructive: make, thing_edit, act

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
